defs.def: a person who plays a musical instrument or writes music, especially as a job 音乐家；作曲家；乐师

ex.t: 它激励了许多年轻的音乐家。

ex.s: In his spare time though he goes on stage beside pianist Maria Raspopova — not as a musician but as her page turner.
ex.t: 但在空闲时间，他登上舞台，站在钢琴家玛丽亚·拉斯波波娃身旁——不是作为音乐家，而是作为她的翻谱员。

ex.s: “I’m not a trained musician, but I’ve learnt to read music so I can help Maria in her performance.”
ex.t: 我不是受过训练的音乐家，但我学会了读谱，这样能在演出中帮助玛丽亚。

ex.s: His job is to sit beside the pianist and turn the pages of the score so the musicians don’t have to break the flow of sound by doing it themselves.
ex.t: 他的工作是坐在钢琴家旁边翻乐谱，这样音乐家就不必自己翻谱而打断音乐的流畅性。

ex.s: The project results from the difficulties many schools have in getting artists of any sort - whether an up-and-coming local musician or a major movie star - into schools to work with and inspire children.
ex.t: 该项目源于许多学校在邀请任何类型的艺术家——无论是崭露头角的本地音乐人还是大牌电影明星——进入学校与儿童合作并启发他们时所面临的困难。

ex.s: Some of the world’s most famous musicians recently gathered in Paris and New Orleans to celebrate the first annual International Jazz Day.
ex.t: 世界上一些最著名的音乐家最近齐聚巴黎和新奥尔良，庆祝首个年度国际爵士日。

ex.s: The Story of a Jazz Musician.
ex.t: 一位爵士音乐家的故事。

ex.s: Not but I think a painter may make a better face, than ever was; but he must do it, by a kind of felicity (as a musician that maketh an excellent air in music) and not by rule.
ex.t: 但我认为画家可以画出比以往更好的面孔；但他必须通过一种巧妙的灵感（就像音乐家创作出优美的旋律），而不是靠规则来做到。

ex.s: Representations of these heavenly musicians, singers and dancers decorate the walls of many caves.
ex.t: 这些天界乐师、歌手和舞者的形象装饰着许多洞穴的墙壁。
